command: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== CURRENT_RELEASE ==='; cat /workspace/omega_runtime/CURRENT_RELEASE.json 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING; echo '=== CURRENT_POINTER ==='; readlink -f /workspace/omega_runtime/current 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== OMEGA_PROCESSES ==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,args | grep -E '[p]ython3 .*omega|[p]ython3 -m omega|[t]mux.*omega' || true; echo '=== TMUX ==='; tmux list-sessions 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== LEGACY_DAEMON ==='; if [ -f /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py ]; then sha256sum /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py; sed -n '1,80p' /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py; else echo MISSING; fi; echo '=== SUPERVISOR_STATUS ==='; cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING; echo '=== RELEASE_HEADS ==='; for d in /workspace/omega_runtime/releases/*; do [ -d "$d/.git" ] || continue; printf '%s ' "$d"; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; done
